commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3997b2a0bc2bbdb30a4aa0fbf62648c32b6bb52d
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
echo production_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo service_state=$(sudo -n systemctl is-active photomap.service)
sudo -n systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID -p WorkingDirectory -p ExecStart -p Environment -p EnvironmentFiles --no-pager
PID=$(sudo -n systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value)
echo main_pid=$PID
echo open_database_fds
sudo -n ls -l /proc/$PID/fd | grep app.db || true
echo candidate_app_db_files
find /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps -type f -name app.db -print
PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from app.core.config import DATABASE_PATH, DATABASE_URL
print('ssh_config_database_url=' + DATABASE_URL)
print('ssh_config_database_path=' + str(DATABASE_PATH))
print('ssh_config_database_exists=' + str(Path(DATABASE_PATH).exists()))
PY
REMOTE
